# History of the package server

This page is for readers who want to know where the package server and its packages come from. Every date and
every quoted commit subject below comes from the Git history of three repositories, which you can check yourself:
[se7enxweb/exponential.packages.exponential.earth](https://github.com/se7enxweb/exponential.packages.exponential.earth)
(the server, 341 commits), [se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/sevenx-ezpackage) (the 7x
packages, 1226 commits) and [se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage](https://github.com/se7enxweb/cjw_multisite-ezpackage)
(16 commits), plus the history of `settings/package.ini` in the kernel and the changelogs in `doc/changelogs/6.0/`.

The vendor that maintains all of it, 7x, was formerly called **Brookins Consulting**; see
[Who is 7x?](../../who-is-7x.md). Exponential grew out of a content management system whose creator discontinued it
after almost 18 years.

## Timeline

| 2014-10-21 | "Added: Initial import of eZ Publish Legacy Package Server Mirror", by Brookins Consulting | server repository |
| 2014-11-15, 2015-03-14 | 5.4 release packages added | server repository |
| 2023-12-24 | 6.0 content added "for release testing from known 5.4.7 packages as a start"; `CNAME`, `FUNDING.yml` and the Pages workflow created | server repository |
| 2023-12-24 | The kernel's `package.ini` names the new server and vendor `7x` (`12ce4a8168`) | kernel, [changelog 6.0.0](../../../../changelogs/6.0/6.0.0.md) |
| 2024-02-29 to 2024-12-03 | Release folders 6.0.1 to 6.0.6 | server repository |
| 2025-01-07 | The server moves to a brand domain; the old address redirects (`5fb85b97f0`) | kernel, [changelog 6.0.7](../../../../changelogs/6.0/6.0.7.md) |
| 2025-01-31 | The 3.x to 5.x folders are removed "Due to GitHub Pages Storage Limits"; 6.0.7 added | server repository |
| 2025-06-10 | Release folders 6.0.8 and 6.0.9 | server repository |
| 2025-08-13 | Rebranding: the folder `ezpublish/` becomes `exponential/`, the host becomes `exponential.packages.exponential.earth`; 6.0.10 added | server repository, kernel `5d3f294bee` |
| 2026-06-05 | Release folder 6.0.14, "with mongodb support"; the kernel moves to it (`46540dc84e`) | server repository, kernel |
| 2026-08-07 | Release folder 6.0.15 with `sevenx_multisite` and `sevenx_multisite_clean` | server repository |
| 2026-08-15 | The kernel's `package.ini` points at 6.0.15 (`f9e77f6740`) | kernel |
| 2026-10-07 | `cjw_multisite` and `cjw_multisite_democontent` added; their source repository created | server repository, cjw_multisite-ezpackage |
| 2026-10-12 | Pages deployments run one at a time | server repository |

## Before 2014: the original vendor's package server

The setting `RemotePackagesIndexURL` is older than Exponential's own server. The kernel's history of
`settings/package.ini` shows it changing with each release from 2007 on, pointing at the package server of the
software's original vendor, with a folder per version (the last of them `5.4/5.4.0`, vendor `eZ-systems`). The
packages of that era (the `ezwebin`, `ezflow` and `ezdemo` site packages among them) are the ancestors of several
packages still on the server today.

## 2014 to 2019: the mirror

On 2014-10-21 Brookins Consulting imported a full mirror of that server into Git: release folders from 3.8 to 5.4,
together with `index.xml` files, thumbnails and a `README.md`. Two more commits in November 2014 and March 2015 added
the 5.4 releases ("Added latest stable releases of 5.4.x packages"). The commits of 2017 and 2019 only repaired the
JavaScript of the browsing page.

On GitHub, today's repository is still marked as a fork of `ezpublishlegacy/packages.ezpublishlegacy.com`, whose
description is "Mirror of packages.ez.no"; that repository was created on 2014-10-21, the date of the first commit.

## December 2023: the 6.0 release folders

On 2023-12-24, 7x started Exponential 6.0's own folder: "Inital adding of 6.0 package content for release testing
from known 5.4.7 packages as a start". The same day:

- `CNAME` and `FUNDING.yml` were created;
- the 6.0.0 `index.xml` was changed "to reflect changed vendor, URLs, version numbers";
- the JavaScript browsing page was replaced by a GitHub Actions workflow that generates directory listings
  ("replaced js browser with GitHub Pages Actions Instead");
- the `ezdemo` extension and site packages were repackaged as bug fix releases.

A week later the first pull request was merged (#1, "Added ezwebin site and site clean packages (patched) for 6.0
release"), followed by `plain_site` on 2024-01-01. In the kernel, commit `12ce4a8168` replaced the original vendor's
server and vendor name in `package.ini` ([changelog 6.0.0](../../../../changelogs/6.0/6.0.0.md)), and `9d38333df9`
replaced addresses that did not work with PHP 8 ([changelog 6.0.1](../../../../changelogs/6.0/6.0.1.md)).

## 2024: a release folder per release

From 2024 on, every release got its own folder, and the kernel's `RemotePackagesIndexURL` moved with it:

| Folder | Added | Commit subject |
|---|---|---|
| 6.0.1, 6.0.2 | 2024-02-29 | "Added release branches for continued package development releases" |
| 6.0.3 | 2024-04-02 | "Added xrowmetadata datatype attribute to most page concept based classes" |
| 6.0.4 | 2024-08-23 | "Import of unified package dependencies for the platform under one core release. Also added admin3 design to installers for sevenx packages" |
| 6.0.5 | 2024-10-01 | "Added 6.0.5 release packages" |
| 6.0.6 | 2024-12-03 | "Added release installation packages for eZ Publish 6.0.6" |

2024 was the busiest year of the repository until then, with 112 commits.

## 2025: storage limits and the Exponential name

- **January.** The server moved to a brand domain; the kernel commit `5fb85b97f0` notes that the old address
  "supports transparent redirection". On 2025-01-31 the release folders of the 3.x to 5.x era were removed: "Due to
  GitHub Pages Storage Limits This repostory is now focused on providing packages which are installable and run aka
  6.0.x". They were kept in a separate repository,
  [se7enxweb/deprecated.ezpublish.packages.ezpublish.one](https://github.com/se7enxweb/deprecated.ezpublish.packages.ezpublish.one),
  created the next day. On 2025-01-31 itself, fifteen numbered commits ("first attempt at restoring deploy using
  new version of upload artifact" to "15th attempt at restoring deploy") reworked the Pages workflow.
- **June.** Folders 6.0.8 and 6.0.9.
- **August.** On 2025-08-13 one commit renamed the top folder from `ezpublish/` to `exponential/`, changed `CNAME` to
  `exponential.packages.exponential.earth` and updated the `README.md`: "Replacing package server url and replacing the
  previous product name. Rebranding." The 6.0.10 folder followed the same day ("rebrand release 6.0.10"), and the
  kernel's settings moved to the new address (`5d3f294bee`; see [changelog 6.0.10](../../../../changelogs/6.0/6.0.10.md)).

There are no folders for 6.0.11, 6.0.12 and 6.0.13: the kernel's `package.ini` did not change between the 6.0.10
address (August 2025) and the 6.0.14 address (June 2026), so those releases kept using the 6.0.10 folder.

## 2026: MongoDB, sevenx_multisite and cjw_multisite

- **June.** 6.0.14 "release site installation packages with mongodb support"; the kernel made it the default for new
  installations (`46540dc84e`).
- **August.** 6.0.15 arrived on 2026-08-07, "including sevenx_multisite (_clean) packages", and the kernel switched to
  it on 2026-08-15. The folder is the largest so far: 44 packages, about 87 MiB.
- **October.** The CJW Multisite packages were added on 2026-10-07. From mid October the installers of the site
  packages were updated many times in place, one commit per package (for example "The sevenx_multisite package's
  installer activates ezownerchange"), and on 2026-10-12 the workflow was changed so that "Pages deployments run one
  at a time". In the kernel, the setup's download was made to retry ([changelog 6.0.15](../../../../changelogs/6.0/6.0.15.md),
  "6 October 2026: the setup's package download").

## The source repositories over time

- **sevenx-ezpackage** carries the package sources from 2006 on: 1226 commits, most of them by the original vendor's
  developers between 2006 and 2014 (it began as the `ezwebin` site package, "Renamed to ezwebin" on 2006-11-15). 7x's
  work starts on 2023-12-24; on 2024-01-14 the base sources were refactored into `sevenx_site` ("Massive refactoring
  of base ezwebin site package sources to sevenx_site"). The multisite packages are in it since 2026-09-07, and the
  build script `packages/build.sh` since 2026-10-14.
- **cjw_multisite-ezpackage** was created on 2026-10-07 with the two CJW Multisite packages, "laid out as the 7x
  package repository, with its scripts that pack each package into its .ezpkg archive".

See [The source repositories](the-source-repositories.md) for all of them.

## Commits per year

| Year | Server repository | sevenx-ezpackage |
|---|---|---|
| 2006 to 2013 | none | 990 |
| 2014 | 4 | 17 |
| 2015, 2017, 2019 | 1 each | none |
| 2023 | 29 | 2 |
| 2024 | 112 | 92 |
| 2025 | 38 | 9 |
| 2026 | 155 | 116 |

Of the 341 commits of the server repository, 8 were made under the Brookins Consulting name and 333 under 7x.
